title: FOOD-005E - Pre-payment physical order truth and bounded lifecycle
purpose: Create immutable pre-payment physical order truth from exact FOOD-005C merchandise quote and FOOD-005D fulfillment/reservation-request snapshots without claiming payment, inventory reservation, dispatch readiness or completed sale.

decisions.creationEvent: A caller explicitly submits one exact validated merchandise quote, one exact quote-bound fulfillment intent and one exact quote-bound reservation request to create order version 1.
decisions.prePaymentMeaning: The resulting order is a physical order request and historical commercial snapshot. It is not proof of payment, sale completion, capacity reservation, dispatch readiness or fulfillment completion.
decisions.reservationBoundary: FOOD-005D reservation requests are retained exactly but remain non-authoritative. FOOD-005E does not invent reservation acceptance while no atomic reservation persistence/service exists.
decisions.merchandiseSnapshot: Order lines copy exact SKU ID/version, approved commercial price authority ID/version, purchase quantity, immutable unit FoodMoney and immutable line merchandise subtotal from FOOD-005C. The order also copies aggregate merchandise subtotal.
decisions.fulfillmentSnapshot: Order truth copies exact fulfillment-intent ID/version, method, opaque location reference and opaque window reference, plus exact reservation-request ID/version and ordered SKU-unit capacity requirements.
decisions.lifecycle: FOOD-005E owns only requested and cancelled. Initial order version is requested. A requested order may receive one explicit consecutive cancelled revision. Cancellation is terminal in this slice.
decisions.paymentBoundary: Paid, payment-authorized, payment-captured, refunded, chargeback and processor state belong to FOOD-005F or later. FOOD-005F must attach payment to an exact order identity/version without repricing or mutating retained merchandise truth.
decisions.operationalBoundary: Scheduled, preparing, ready, dispatched and handed-over states are deferred until trusted payment and fulfillment authorities exist.
decisions.moneyBoundary: FOOD-005E carries merchandise subtotal only. Tax, discounts, tips, delivery fee, processor fees, grand total and amount due are not introduced.
decisions.timeBoundary: No system clock or supplied order timestamps are introduced yet. Persistence/audit timestamp policy remains separately authorized.
decisions.customerBoundary: Guest/customer/account/contact identity is deferred to FOOD-005G.
decisions.concurrency: Repository idempotency, atomic creation, reservation acceptance, stock/slot races and conflict handling are deferred to a later persistence/service slice.

invariants: later price revision does not reprice order history
later quote does not mutate order history
later fulfillment-intent revision does not retarget order history
later reservation-request revision does not retarget order history

future.FOOD-005F: Attach separately validated payment truth to exact order identity/version without changing historical merchandise, pricing or fulfillment snapshots.
future.FOOD-005H: Labels, barcode, QR and reorder foundations.

operations: Exactly three local files only. No staging, commit, push, persistence, production access or deployment.
